title: A better way to explore
changes: Redesigned map with dedicated Charging and Rivian Places views, category filters, and distinct markers for Spaces, Demo Centers, Service Centers, Outposts, RAN, and Waypoints.
Expanded charging details include pricing, connector types, charging speeds, and individual port information where available.
Color-coded charging ratings appear in search results, map details, saved places, and location pages.
Automatic data refreshes keep location information current, with dated maintenance and charger issue reports in location details.
